node.title: Re: PayPal IPN Script End of script output before headers:
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Is that really all that the server log says? What is the output when you run the script from the command line? See also [id://165253] and [id://380424]. Perhaps try adding use CGI::Carp qw/fatalsToBrowser/; to the top of your script (for debugging only!).
